title: Weekly Updates #1
imageCaption: Photo of the 18 Gym Leaders (AI Generated)
intro: It's been a few intense days of work! Here's a rundown of everything that changed in the game:

sections.heading: New stuff
items: We now have 18 Gym Leaders, with teams drawn by strength tier and their own dedicated pools per type (including the return of a Fairy-only gym).
Overhauled Legendary/Mythical capture, Mega Evolution, and Absol's "sense" (special ability).
Fishing Bait and a reworked achievements system.
Created an official Discord server to keep the community updated.

sections.heading: Balance
items: Nuzlocke is fairer now: more voluntary swaps per battle, adjusted catch rates, Potions heal full HP.
Overall difficulty smoothed out for newer players, with a less absurd endgame.
Gym Leader teams and trade offers now scale better with player strength.
Battle AI got smarter: it weighs expected damage and type effectiveness.
Wild encounter reroll limited to 1 use per encounter.

sections.heading: Bug fixes
items: Mega Evolution with form choice (Charizard, Mewtwo, Raichu X/Y) wasn't working, fixed.
Fixed a post-Rival encounter loop and several checkpoint bugs.
Fixed Mega Tackle, implemented real Counter/Mirror Coat.
Fixed the Fishing button getting stuck after buying more bait.
Leaderboard names are now properly validated and escaped.

sections.heading: Interface
items: Back button on the trade screen, simplified trade screens.
Reorganized and expanded the FAQ (new battle system section, AI-generated art disclosure, tables reordered).
Favicon, meta description, and accessibility tweaks (focus states).
